steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Energy store: A way in which energy can be stored within a system. Energy is never created or destroyed — it is only transferred between stores. | System: An object or group of objects. You define the system to describe what is happening with energy. | Conservation of energy: Energy cannot be created or destroyed, only transferred usefully, stored or dissipated (wasted). | Dissipation: Energy that is transferred to a thermal store of the surroundings that is not useful. This is often called wasted energy.
